item.title: The Wendy’s JRPG Is a Searing Anti-Capitalist Screed About Humans Making Real Art
item.description: Over the past year, Wendy’s — yes, the same Wendy’s known for its square burgers, thick milkshakes, and unlikely stewardship of a mid-tier donut chain — has made waves through a series of unconventional creative partnerships. Amid slumps in sales and attention , Wendy’s has turned to popular artistic mediums, like music and video games, to try and reverse course.

item.title: Xbox Game Pass November 2026 Lineup Announced
item.description: Xbox Game Pass subscribers have another batch of games to look forward to as Microsoft expands its subscription library with new additions throughout November. The latest announcement includes everything from a new co-op escape room adventure to a minimalist kingdom-building strategy game and a bullet-heaven spin-off set in the Warhammer universe .

item.title: Ubisoft Makes Bid to Purchase Xbox Studio on the Brink of Closure
item.description: Microsoft intends to divest from Dishonored and Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Studios as part of its mass layoffs at Xbox and other Microsoft divisions. Because Arkane is based in Lyon, France, Xbox has had to adhere to French labor laws, and was mandated to search for a potential buyer for Arkane.

item.title: Mass Effect Fans Are Trying to Make This N7 Day the Biggest One Ever
item.description: The fan group We Are Mass Effect is asking players on any platform to boot up a Mass Effect game at the same time on Saturday, Nov. 7, from 2 to 5 p.m. ET (11 a.m. to 2 p.m. PT, 7 to 10 p.m. GMT and 8 to 11 p.m. CET). The idea is to see as many people as possible playing at once to truly demonstrate (with data!) how many of us love and are still actively enjoying Mass Effect.

item.title: DC Studios Has Officially Cast Its New Robin
item.description: DC Studios has multiple Batman and Batman-adjacent projects in the works, like its The Brave and the Bold movie and a Poison Ivy TV series . On the docket for 2028 is Dynamic Duo , an ambitious animated film about two Robins: Dick Grayson and Jason Todd. It will use a combination of miniatures, puppetry, animatronics, and CGI to bring its heroes to life.

item.title: WoW: Forever's Beta Was Pure Magic. No One Knows What Happens Next
item.description: I only took the character to level 6, however. I realized that this was the character I'd want to play and the path I'd want to follow in the live game when it launches this week, on Nov. 4, and I didn't want to spoil that experience. At the same time, I felt a professional obligation to check out Forever 's brand-new race, the Skyborne elves, and their flying-island starting zone, Zephras Isle. So I started again, with a Skyborne Druid.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Is Reprinting a Powerful $30 Sword With Perfect Pixel Art
item.description: Magic: The Gathering is reaching into its inventory of powerful artifacts to reprint a sword worth nearly $30, complete with gloriously nostalgic video game artwork. Sword of Truth and Justice , a popular Equipment first released in 2019, is returning in a new Secret Lair collection that draws inspiration from the blocky, polygonal graphics of the Nintendo 64 and original PlayStation era.

item.title: Sony Pushes PS5 Owners To Trade In Consoles Amid Unprecedented Price Hikes
item.description: The future of affordable video game consoles is not looking good, and hardware makers like Sony know it. The PlayStation 5 has undergone two major price hikes while the Xbox Series X has jumped in price three times in a single year. The AI-driven VRAM crisis at the heart of the issue is expected to worsen. Given the supply constraints, Sony has limited options for selling PS5s at prices customers might find acceptable.

item.title: For GTA 6, Xbox Put an Xbox Series X in an Alligator
item.description: Xbox has come up with a rather unusual way to celebrate Florida wildlife ahead of the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 launch, unveiling a custom Xbox Series X that looks like it has been swallowed whole by an alligator. Even stranger, the console inside actually works, and one lucky fan could soon have the bizarre gaming accessory sitting in their home.
